criteria.text: A successful reproduction retains the exact cause, flaw and class and each discovered relation with its actual quote and source in the run and PR 1, including after refresh.
An empty relation search is recorded honestly; a failed reproduction never invents a cause.
Agent findings remain inert in PR text and never become check results.

cases.given: A successful reproduction and two discovered issues with actual source quotes
cases.required_observation: Both requested lines and both classifications survive run storage and PR 1 refresh.

cases.given: A successful reproduction found no other issues
cases.required_observation: The record and PR 1 distinguish an empty search from an unavailable search.

cases.given: Findings contain Markdown, mentions, closing words and ownership markers
cases.required_observation: Rendering does not notify, forge ownership or close an issue; check results remain unchanged.
